note: Conceptual lesson on building a field-level mapping document, resolving type mismatches, and picklist value translation. This is general enterprise data-migration practice applied to a Salesforce target schema, with no vendor-specific product claims that needed verification beyond the general, well-established fact that Salesforce field API names persist independent of display labels and that picklist fields enforce a fixed value set. No screenshot is used per this course's conceptual/architecture screenshot policy.
